title: AgriSenseMultiSourceFeatureSchema
description: Unified machine-readable feature contract for multi-source environmental and agricultural data integration in AgriSense AI.
data_integrity_statement: The current benchmark agricultural dataset lacks the geospatial and temporal keys required to legitimately join live weather, satellite, and soil observations. Therefore, Phase 7 creates the multi-source feature contract and alignment infrastructure without fabricating historical environmental observations.
missing_data_policy: Missing values are explicitly preserved as null. No synthetic zero, mean, median, or randomized imputation is permitted in Phase 7 feature construction.
target_leakage_policy: Supervised target labels (crop_label) are strictly separated from feature representations and must never be included in prediction feature vectors or feature matrices.

features.name: nitrogen
features.meaning: Available Nitrogen (N) content in soil
features.temporal_meaning: Soil nutrient test / baseline crop measurement

features.name: phosphorus
features.meaning: Available Phosphorus (P) content in soil
features.temporal_meaning: Soil nutrient test / baseline crop measurement

features.name: potassium
features.meaning: Available Potassium (K) content in soil
features.temporal_meaning: Soil nutrient test / baseline crop measurement

features.name: historical_temperature
features.meaning: Historical seasonal mean temperature from crop dataset
features.temporal_meaning: Seasonal growing period average

features.name: historical_humidity
features.meaning: Historical mean relative humidity from crop dataset
features.temporal_meaning: Seasonal growing period average

features.name: historical_ph
features.meaning: Soil pH measured in historical crop dataset
features.temporal_meaning: Soil sample measurement

features.name: historical_rainfall
features.meaning: Historical seasonal cumulative rainfall from crop dataset
features.temporal_meaning: Seasonal growing period cumulative

features.name: n_p_ratio
features.meaning: Nitrogen to Phosphorus balance ratio (N / P). Evaluates to null when P <= 0.
features.temporal_meaning: Stoichiometric nutrient ratio derived from sample

features.name: n_k_ratio
features.meaning: Nitrogen to Potassium balance ratio (N / K). Evaluates to null when K <= 0.
features.temporal_meaning: Stoichiometric nutrient ratio derived from sample

features.name: p_k_ratio
features.meaning: Phosphorus to Potassium balance ratio (P / K). Evaluates to null when K <= 0.
features.temporal_meaning: Stoichiometric nutrient ratio derived from sample

features.name: weather_temperature
features.meaning: Air temperature at 2m above ground from meteorological service
features.temporal_meaning: Instantaneous or forecast meteorological observation timestamp

features.name: weather_humidity
features.meaning: Relative humidity percentage at 2m above ground
features.temporal_meaning: Instantaneous or forecast meteorological observation timestamp

features.name: weather_precipitation
features.meaning: Precipitation / rainfall amount from meteorological service
features.temporal_meaning: Observation interval accumulation

features.name: weather_wind_speed
features.meaning: Wind speed at 10m above ground from meteorological service
features.temporal_meaning: Instantaneous observation timestamp

features.name: satellite_ndvi
features.meaning: Median Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (B8 - B4)/(B8 + B4)
features.temporal_meaning: Zonal median aggregated over cloud-filtered temporal window

features.name: satellite_ndwi
features.meaning: Median Normalized Difference Water Index (B3 - B8)/(B3 + B8)
features.temporal_meaning: Zonal median aggregated over cloud-filtered temporal window

features.name: satellite_ndmi
features.meaning: Median Normalized Difference Moisture Index (B8 - B11)/(B8 + B11)
features.temporal_meaning: Zonal median aggregated over cloud-filtered temporal window

features.name: satellite_usable_observations
features.meaning: Count of usable Sentinel-2 scenes in the composited window
features.temporal_meaning: Observation count over temporal window

features.name: satellite_cloud_probability_threshold
features.meaning: Pixel cloud probability threshold applied for cloud screening
features.temporal_meaning: Screening filter parameter

features.name: soil_ph
features.meaning: Soil pH in H2O normalized from SoilGrids 2.0 (pH*10 / 10)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_clay_pct
features.meaning: Clay content percentage (mass fraction g/100g, converted from g/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_sand_pct
features.meaning: Sand content percentage (mass fraction g/100g, converted from g/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_silt_pct
features.meaning: Silt content percentage (mass fraction g/100g, converted from g/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_organic_carbon_g_kg
features.meaning: Soil organic carbon in fine earth fraction (converted from dg/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_bulk_density
features.meaning: Bulk density of fine earth fraction (converted from cg/cm³)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_cec
features.meaning: Cation Exchange Capacity at pH 7 (converted from mmol(c)/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

features.name: soil_nitrogen_g_kg
features.meaning: Total nitrogen in soil fine earth fraction (converted from cg/kg)
features.temporal_meaning: Static spatial pedological reference (ISRIC digital soil map)

target.name: crop_label
target.meaning: Supervised agricultural crop classification label (22 multiclass labels in benchmark)
target.isolation: MUST NEVER be used as an input feature for ML prediction models.
